findings.title: No required-column validation
findings.note: Partial and empty feature dicts are accepted; missing fields imputed as 0 → silent wrong score.

findings.title: entity_id not set on case scoring
findings.note: Project UI predict rarely passes entity_id; feedback hard to join to a customer later.

findings.title: Conformal residual bands often very wide
findings.note: Sample mean width 0.82. Soft rules fixed over-flagging, but interval is weak for tight decision thresholds.

findings.title: No counterfactual explanations
findings.note: Drivers are attribution only — no 'minimal change to flip decision' (related to B2/B4).

findings.title: Explain is local, slow path ~SHAP+LIME every case
findings.note: Every predict with explain runs dual methods; no cache by feature hash; weak for bulk prioritization.

findings.title: Templates + aliases, not domain learning
findings.note: Feature mapping is fixed alias table; novel columns fall back to generic wording.

findings.title: Regression gets no insight brief
findings.note: CaseExplainer + InsightGenerator gated to non-regression.

findings.title: Action impact is heuristic, not simulated counterfactual
findings.note: expected_probability_reduction from catalog math — not re-running predict under action effects.

findings.title: Catalog is generic/churn-tilted
findings.note: Default action catalog not industry-agnostic generation; weak for non-churn binary projects.

findings.title: Single-scenario what-if only
findings.note: No Monte Carlo distribution; delta itself has no CI.

findings.title: No action→feature effect model
findings.note: You edit features manually; system doesn't map 'offer discount' → feature shifts.

findings.title: Very large scenario deltas possible
findings.note: impact=-0.82 with 1–2 edits — user may over-trust without uncertainty on the delta.

findings.title: Simulate persists two prediction rows
findings.note: simulate calls predict twice → DB fills with sim noise/prediction_id noise.

findings.title: Success definition is outcome-avoidance only
findings.note: success_n = avoided positive class; wrong framing for non-churn positives (e.g. conversion).

findings.title: No scheduled recheck / autopsy / decision object
findings.note: A7 is stamp on prediction row — design B3 still missing.

findings.title: Notes not stored; no audit trail of overwrites
findings.note: updates overwrite silently.

findings.title: UI feedback only in PredictionPanel with prediction_id
findings.note: Must complete live predict; cannot log offline from historical prediction list alone easily.

findings.title: No project retrain from feedback accumulation
findings.note: Demo FeedbackService has triggers; SaaS project path doesn't.

findings.title: Classification-first product surface
findings.note: Explain/Insight/Rec/Feedback log UI heavily gates regression.

findings.title: Dual demo + SaaS stacks
findings.note: Demo /feedback and project /projects/{id}/feedback diverge.

findings.title: No batch prioritize/explain API
findings.note: Cannot sort 1000 accounts by risk+soft+recs without N sequential predict calls.

findings.title: Latency/cost of full case path unmeasured in CI
findings.note: No SLO/regression suite for time per case with SHAP+LIME on.

findings.title: Multiclass / time-series not in A
findings.note: binary + regression only.

findings.title: Human-in-loop 'why we disagreed' not closed
findings.note: knownOutcome conflicts shown but no structured miss review workflow.
